item.title: North Dakota State Announces 2026 Football Recruiting Class
item.description: FARGO, N.D. (NDSU ATHLETICS)– The North Dakota State University football program has added 29 high school student-athletes and nine transfers for the 2026 season. item.title: Measles case confirmed in Williams County, North Dakota
item.description: BISMARCK, N.D. (KVRR) — The first case of measles for 2026 in North Dakota is reported. North Dakota Department of Health and Human Services says the confirmed case is in Williams County, located in the northwest part of the state.
